profile.summary: Sutter Bay Hospitals is a California nonprofit corporation that operates hospitals in the San Francisco Bay Area as part of the Sutter Health system. Its hospitals include Alta Bates Summit Medical Center, which has campuses in Berkeley and Oakland and provides hospital care such as maternity, newborn intensive care, stroke care and specialty surgery.
